content:
Ana (Marketing): Quick sync — Oakridge case study: transcript approved but we still need a clean pull quote + legal signoff. Planning a short launch post and to feature them in the May 14 webinar. Need logo clearance + lead routing plan. Can we get this wrapped by EOD Wed?
Kristin (AE): I can chase the final logo approval with Oakridge contact today. Will ping them now.
Sarah (CS): I have the interview notes. There's a nice line about cost savings that could work as a quote.
Mike (Product): Share the candidate quote and I can make it concise for the post. Also, are we ok linking to benchmark data?
Ana (Marketing): Good Q. We should link only to our published benchmarks, not their internal numbers.
Sarah (CS): Candidate quote (raw):
```
"Redwood cut our inference costs by more than half and made latency consistently under 80ms in production."
```
Kristin (AE): That reads a bit technical — Oakridge marketing may want a customer-facing spin. Suggest: 
```
"Redwood helped us reduce inference costs and make app responses noticeably faster for customers."
```
Mike (Product): I prefer including a concrete result if legal ok. Maybe: 
```
"We reduced inference costs by ~50% and saw much faster customer responses."
```
Dave (Legal): @Ana @Kristin I reviewed the transcript extract. High level okay but flag: the use of a percentage (50%) could be considered a performance claim. We need their written approval for any numeric claims and a short consent line for publishing. Also confirm no customer PII in the excerpt.
Ana (Marketing): Got it. @Sarah can you ask Oakridge to confirm the numeric claim and send an explicit publishing nod? Kristin — can you handle lead consent + logo TOS routing?
Kristin (AE): Yep. I'll request: (1) explicit approval of the final quote, (2) logo usage approval, (3) permission to route webinar registrants as inbound leads to Oakridge (if they want).
Jen (Design): Once we have final quote + logo, I can spin up the hero image + short social card. Need vector logo and brand colors.
Sarah (CS): Reached out to Oakridge (Amanda). She replied: "happy to approve quote but remove the exact percent — prefer 'significant' — and logo ok. Will send formal approval"
Mike (Product): That works. Suggest final quote: 
```
"Redwood helped us reduce inference costs and deliver noticeably faster responses for our users."
```
Ana (Marketing): Love it. @Dave does that avoid the numeric-claim concern?
Dave (Legal): Yes, that removes the explicit metric so lower risk. Still request the written signoff doc from Oakridge before publish. Also attach their logo release email to the case file.
webhook-bot: Reminder: Marketing launch checklist item added (#case-study-oakridge) by Ana.
Kristin (AE): Oakridge sent their signed approval doc and attached logo (svg + png). Forwarded to @Jen and @Dave.
Jen (Design): Received — will produce hero + social variants by Fri EOD.
Ana (Marketing): Next: webinar slot. We have May 14 11am PT open. Need Oakridge speaker + 10-min case highlight. Kristin, can you confirm?
Kristin (AE): Confirmed with Amanda — she'll speak for 10 mins and join the panel Q&A. Also asked whether Oakridge wants leads routed to their AE team; they said yes, but want a qualifying filter (MQL+).
Mike (Product): For routing, can we attach a tag to webinar registrants that meet criteria? Then send only tagged leads.
Kristin (AE): Yes — I'll coordinate with Sales Ops to implement tag + webhook to Oakridge webhook endpoint.
Dave (Legal): One more: include a brief release clause in the post: "Quoted with permission." We have the signed note so fine. Save copy to legal folder.
Ana (Marketing): Great. To confirm deadlines: Kristin secures lead routing config by Mon, Jen delivers assets by Fri, Dave drops final note into legal folder on approval receipt, and I write the launch post draft by Thu for review.
Sarah (CS): I'll prepare a 2-paragraph case summary for the post (customer-friendly).
Kristin (AE): Sales Ops: @mike (Product) are you ok to set up the webhook + tag mapping?
Mike (Product): I'll create the tag in the webinar platform and expose a webhook endpoint. Send me the field mapping and sample payload.
Ana (Marketing): I'll draft the launch post and a short webinar blurb. Quick ask: keep the quote short so it's usable in social cards.
Jen (Design): Noted. We'll design with the short quote and a longer pull for the detailed page.
Dave (Legal): Once assets final, please paste final quote + logo permission into this thread for record.
Ana (Marketing): Will do. Thanks all :partyparrot:
